criterion: 八組欄位與步驟子表可呈現且引用一致，區分同步結果、非同步接受、傳輸及遠端完成，無關項目可明示不適用，不暴露私有算法。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: Eight flow groups reference interface contracts and step-level completion semantics; unrelated fields carry explicit reasons. limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
